learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn a valuable lesson about being happy with what we have through a classic animal story!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A stag was very proud of his beautiful horns but did not like his thin legs. We should not judge things just by how they look.
When danger came the ugly legs helped him run away but the beautiful horns got stuck in the trees. True value is in being useful.

fun_activity.title: 🎭 Animal Acting
fun_activity.instructions: Pretend to be different animals in the forest. Try walking gracefully like a deer or flying like an owl!

quick_recap: ⭐ All things have their own special value.
⭐ We should love ourselves just the way we are.
⭐ Sometimes things that look ordinary are the most useful.
